testSuite: NexusPlay Sprint 01 Identity & Security Advanced Verification (Hardened)
securityControlsVerified: SHA-256 Hashed Password Reset Tokens at Rest
Cascade Session Revocation Across Devices on Reset
Genuine Password Reset Email Dispatch to Outbox
SQLite-Backed Rate Limiting Surviving Process Restarts

tests.name: Successful registration issues user profile, session token, and HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie
tests.expected: HTTP 201 with session token and HttpOnly cookie

tests.name: Duplicate email registration is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
tests.actual: HTTP 409 (An account with this email address already exists)

tests.name: Invalid email format rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
Password shorter than 8 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must be between 8 and 64 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Password without numbers rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must contain at least one number)

tests.name: Display name under 2 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.expected: HTTP 400 with display name constraint error
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Display name must be between 2 and 32 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Valid credentials return HTTP 200 with HttpOnly session cookie & CSRF token
Incorrect password returns HTTP 401 with generic error message
Non-existent email returns identical HTTP 401 (prevents user enumeration)
Session validates via ambient HttpOnly Cookie without Authorization header
CSRF Protection: Mutating cookie request without X-CSRF-Token rejected with HTTP 403
tests.actual: HTTP 403 (CSRF token validation failed. Missing or invalid X-CSRF-Token header.)

tests.name: Logout invalidates session and clears HttpOnly session cookies
Revoked session cookie rejected on subsequent requests with HTTP 401
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Forgot password generates 15m reset token and dispatches genuine email to outbox
tests.expected: HTTP 200 and email dispatched with resetToken

tests.name: Password reset token is cryptographically hashed at rest (SHA-256) in persistence
tests.expected: DB token matches SHA-256 hash of raw reset token

tests.name: Forgot password for unknown email returns identical HTTP 200 with zero outbound email
Reset password with valid token updates credentials with HTTP 200
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (Password has been reset successfully. Please log in with your new credentials.)

tests.name: Re-using already spent reset token rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token is invalid or has already been used)

tests.name: Password reset immediately revokes all prior active sessions across devices
tests.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for prior active session
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Successfully login with updated password following reset
Expired reset token (>15m) rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token has expired. Please request a new reset link.)

tests.name: 5 consecutive failed login attempts trigger HTTP 429 lockout with Retry-After header
tests.expected: HTTP 429 on 5th failure with Retry-After header

tests.name: Rate limit lockout persists across application restarts via persistent database storage
tests.expected: Lockout remains active after in-memory state wipe (HTTP 429)

tests.name: Rate limit lockout isolates by IP+email composite key without blocking other users
Successful login clears failed attempt counter, preventing premature lockout
tests.expected: HTTP 200 resets counter; subsequent failure shows remainingAttempts=4

tests.name: Distributed Brute-Force Defense: Enforces target email protection against rotating IPs
tests.expected: HTTP 429 on 10th distributed attempt across rotating IPs
tests.actual: 10th attempt from new IP -> HTTP 429 (Too many failed authentication attempts. Account access is temporarily locked.)

tests.name: Accessing protected /api/v1/auth/me without token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Authentication required. No session token or cookie provided.)

tests.name: Accessing protected endpoint with invalid token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)
